name: method-core
description: The Dark Factory method itself — the stage pipeline, the evidence gate, and the operating stance. Every other kit assumes this one.
$note: The floor. A kit that is not method-core should not restate these; it should depend on them being installed alongside.
$harnessNote: Skills are portable as-is — Codex CLI reads the same SKILL.md format. HOOK WIRING IS NOT: Claude Code uses settings.json, Codex uses hooks.json / [hooks] in config.toml, and Codex implements a superset of the events (11 vs 5). The hook SCRIPTS are shared; the wiring is rendered per harness by the consuming instance. ⚠️ UNVERIFIED: that these hook scripts run unchanged under Codex is inferred from its documentation, not measured. Do not claim Codex support on this line alone.

$excluded.requirements-discovery: The four-round interview is generic, its REQUIREMENTS-TEMPLATE.md is one estate's services and pipeline. The rounds belong here; the template does not.
$excluded.$developAndTestNote: develop-and-test was listed here until 2026-09-01 for the same reason, and was then REMOVED FROM THIS REPO rather than fixed. Measured before deleting: no kit named it, dark-factory-build / vinculum-loop / df-tdd-developer never referenced it, and no loop had ever invoked it -- the method's build stage is df-tdd-developer. A skill coupled to one estate that nothing in the method calls is a fork living in the wrong repo, and all three estates already carry their own copy. This note stays because an entry that simply vanishes reads as one nobody decided.
